card.name: Verbs of changing or removing a step
card.fires_on: Words that describe redoing, cutting off, suspending or temporarily changing something, such as redefined, temporarily, suspended, cut off. It appears in math explanations and in drug-label instructions to change a dose.

modes.label: Math steps
modes.description: Verbs and small words in worked math or measuring explanations about redefining, multiplying or cutting off parts.
modes.example: I took the inner contents of the function and re<<defined>> that as g(x).

modes.label: Temporary dose change
modes.description: Words about temporarily reducing or suspending a drug or dose in label instructions.
modes.example: in order to predict the INR on warfarin alone,<< temporarily>> reduce the dose of Argatroban Injection
